name: twisted-loft
why: Loft vertex pairing taken literally, against a closed form: the ruled loft between a square and the same square a quarter turn on has section area a^2((1-t)^2+t^2), so V = 2/3 a^2 L = 2000 mm3 exactly. OCCT's ThruSections compatibility pass used to re-origin the wires and silently rebuild this as the straight 3000 mm3 prism — right sections, wrong solid, no error — so the volume is the tripwire for that pass ever coming back.
